# Tutorial Questions: Module 3 {-}

Note: * Indicates **Expanded** Competencies

```{=html}
<style>
  .ne-box{max-width:760px;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:8px;padding:16px;margin:14px 0;background:#fff;}
  .ne-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .ne-tab-btn{padding:7px 14px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;background:#f2f2f2;cursor:pointer;font-size:.9rem;}
  .ne-tab-btn.active{background:#2a7ae2;color:#fff;border-color:#2a7ae2;}
  .ne-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:.9rem;}
  .ne-controls select, .ne-controls input[type=number]{padding:5px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;}
  .ne-controls input[type=number]{width:90px;}
  .ne-svg-area, .ne-svg-value{width:100%;height:auto;background:#fafcff;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:6px;}
  .ne-result-area, .ne-result-value{margin-top:8px;font-size:.95rem;background:#f6fbff;border-left:5px solid #2b8cbe;padding:.5rem .8rem;border-radius:4px;min-height:1.4em;}
  .ne-context{font-size:.88rem;color:#555;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .qbox{max-width:760px;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin:12px 0;background:#fff;}
  .qbox textarea{width:100%;min-height:4rem;padding:6px;box-sizing:border-box;}
  .qbox .btn{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;background:#f7f7f7;cursor:pointer;margin-top:8px;margin-right:6px;}
  .qbox .qchk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.88rem;margin-top:4px;}
  .qbox-answer{background:#f6fbff;border-left:6px solid #2b8cbe;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-radius:6px;margin-top:.7rem;display:none;font-size:.92rem;}
  .zcheck-box{max-width:760px;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:8px;padding:14px;margin:12px 0;background:#fafcff;}
  .zcheck-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:6px 0;}
  .zcheck-row input{width:100px;padding:5px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;text-align:center;}
  .zcheck-row.correct input{border-color:#2e8b45;background:#eaffea;}
  .zcheck-row.incorrect input{border-color:#c0392b;background:#fdeaea;}
</style>

<script>
window.NE = (function(){
  const ZMIN=-4, ZMAX=4, MAXD=0.398942280401433;

  function zDensity(z){ return Math.exp(-z*z/2)/Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI); }

  function normalCDF(z){
    const b1=0.319381530,b2=-0.356563782,b3=1.781477937,b4=-1.821255978,b5=1.330274429,p=0.2316419,c=0.39894228;
    const az=Math.abs(z);
    const t=1/(1+p*az);
    const poly=t*(t*(t*(t*(t*b5+b4)+b3)+b2)+b1);
    const tail=c*Math.exp(-az*az/2)*poly;
    return z>=0 ? 1-tail : tail;
  }

  function normalInv(p){
    if(p<=0) return -Infinity;
    if(p>=1) return Infinity;
    const a=[-3.969683028665376e+01,2.209460984245205e+02,-2.759285104469687e+02,1.383577518672690e+02,-3.066479806614716e+01,2.506628277459239e+00];
    const b=[-5.447609879822406e+01,1.615858368580409e+02,-1.556989798598866e+02,6.680131188771972e+01,-1.328068155288572e+01];
    const c=[-7.784894002430293e-03,-3.223964580411365e-01,-2.400758277161838e+00,-2.549732539343734e+00,4.374664141464968e+00,2.938163982698783e+00];
    const d=[7.784695709041462e-03,3.224671290700398e-01,2.445134137142996e+00,3.754408661907416e+00];
    const plow=0.02425, phigh=1-plow;
    let q,r;
    if(p<plow){
      q=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(p));
      return (((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) / ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    } else if(p<=phigh){
      q=p-0.5; r=q*q;
      return (((((a[0]*r+a[1])*r+a[2])*r+a[3])*r+a[4])*r+a[5])*q / (((((b[0]*r+b[1])*r+b[2])*r+b[3])*r+b[4])*r+1);
    } else {
      q=Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(1-p));
      return -(((((c[0]*q+c[1])*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5]) / ((((d[0]*q+d[1])*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+1);
    }
  }

  function pxX(z){ return 30 + (z-ZMIN)/(ZMAX-ZMIN)*540; }
  function pxY(d){ return 190 - (d/MAXD)*150; }

  function outlinePath(){
    let d="";
    for(let z=ZMIN; z<=ZMAX+1e-9; z+=0.08){
      const x=pxX(z), y=pxY(zDensity(z));
      d += (d===""?"M":" L") + x + " " + y;
    }
    return d;
  }

  function shadePath(zLo, zHi){
    const lo=Math.max(ZMIN,zLo), hi=Math.min(ZMAX,zHi);
    if(hi<=lo) return "";
    let d="M"+pxX(lo)+" 190";
    for(let z=lo; z<=hi+1e-9; z+=0.06){
      d += " L "+pxX(z)+" "+pxY(zDensity(z));
    }
    d += " L "+pxX(hi)+" 190 Z";
    return d;
  }

  function fmt(n, dp){ return Number(n).toFixed(dp===undefined?2:dp); }

  function init(containerId, opts){
    const mu = opts.mu, sigma = opts.sigma, unit = opts.unit || "", symbol = opts.symbol || "y", precision = opts.precision===undefined?2:opts.precision;
    const root = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if(!root) return;

    root.querySelectorAll(".ne-outline").forEach(o => o.setAttribute("d", outlinePath()));

    function toZ(y){ return (Number(y)-mu)/sigma; }
    function toY(z){ return mu + z*sigma; }

    const regionSel = root.querySelector(".ne-region");
    const val1 = root.querySelector(".ne-val1");
    const val2wrap = root.querySelector(".ne-val2-wrap");
    const val2 = root.querySelector(".ne-val2");
    const shadeArea = root.querySelector(".ne-shade-area");
    const resultArea = root.querySelector(".ne-result-area");

    function renderArea(){
      const region = regionSel.value;
      val2wrap.style.display = region==="between" ? "inline-flex" : "none";
      const v1 = Number(val1.value);
      if (val1.value==="" || isNaN(v1)) { shadeArea.setAttribute("d",""); resultArea.textContent=""; return; }
      const z1 = toZ(v1);
      let zLo, zHi, prob, desc;
      if(region==="above"){
        zLo=z1; zHi=4; prob = 1-normalCDF(z1);
        desc = symbol + " > " + fmt(v1,precision) + (unit? " "+unit : "");
      } else if(region==="below"){
        zLo=-4; zHi=z1; prob = normalCDF(z1);
        desc = symbol + " < " + fmt(v1,precision) + (unit? " "+unit : "");
      } else {
        const v2 = Number(val2.value);
        if (val2.value==="" || isNaN(v2)) { shadeArea.setAttribute("d",""); resultArea.textContent=""; return; }
        const z2 = toZ(v2);
        zLo=Math.min(z1,z2); zHi=Math.max(z1,z2);
        prob = normalCDF(zHi)-normalCDF(zLo);
        desc = fmt(Math.min(v1,v2),precision) + " < " + symbol + " < " + fmt(Math.max(v1,v2),precision) + (unit? " "+unit : "");
      }
      shadeArea.setAttribute("d", shadePath(zLo,zHi));
      resultArea.innerHTML = "<strong>" + desc + "</strong>: proportion = " + fmt(prob,4) + " (about " + fmt(prob*100,2) + "%)";
    }

    [regionSel,val1,val2].forEach(el=>{ if(el) el.addEventListener("input", renderArea); });
    renderArea();

    const region2 = root.querySelector(".ne-region2");
    const pctInput = root.querySelector(".ne-pct");
    const shadeValue = root.querySelector(".ne-shade-value");
    const resultValue = root.querySelector(".ne-result-value");

    function renderValue(){
      if(!region2) return;
      const region = region2.value;
      const pct = Number(pctInput.value);
      if (pctInput.value==="" || isNaN(pct) || pct<=0 || pct>=100) { shadeValue.setAttribute("d",""); resultValue.textContent=""; return; }
      const p = pct/100;
      let zLo, zHi, text;
      if(region==="lowest"){
        const z = normalInv(p);
        zLo=-4; zHi=z;
        text = "z = " + fmt(z,2) + (symbol!=="z" ? (", " + symbol + " = " + fmt(toY(z),precision) + (unit? " "+unit:"")) : "");
      } else if(region==="highest"){
        const z = normalInv(1-p);
        zLo=z; zHi=4;
        text = "z = " + fmt(z,2) + (symbol!=="z" ? (", " + symbol + " = " + fmt(toY(z),precision) + (unit? " "+unit:"")) : "");
      } else {
        const zHiVal = normalInv((1+p)/2);
        const zLoVal = -zHiVal;
        zLo=zLoVal; zHi=zHiVal;
        text = "z = " + fmt(zLoVal,2) + " to " + fmt(zHiVal,2) + (symbol!=="z" ? (", " + symbol + " = " + fmt(toY(zLoVal),precision) + " to " + fmt(toY(zHiVal),precision) + (unit? " "+unit:"")) : "");
      }
      shadeValue.setAttribute("d", shadePath(zLo,zHi));
      resultValue.innerHTML = "<strong>Cut-off:</strong> " + text;
    }

    [region2,pctInput].forEach(el=>{ if(el) el.addEventListener("input", renderValue); });
    renderValue();

    const tabBtns = root.querySelectorAll(".ne-tab-btn");
    const panels = root.querySelectorAll(".ne-panel");
    tabBtns.forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
        tabBtns.forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        panels.forEach(p=> p.style.display = (p.dataset.panel===btn.dataset.tab) ? "block" : "none");
      });
    });
  }

  return { init, normalCDF, normalInv };
})();
</script>
```

## Question 1: Using Standard Normal Tables

Draw a picture of the standard Normal curve. Mark in the position and values of the mean and standard deviation. A standard Normal model has a mean $\mu = 0$ and standard deviation $\sigma = 1$.

Now use your diagram of the Normal Distribution and Table Z to answer the following questions.

### (a) What percentage of a standard Normal model is found in each region? {-}

i. $z > 1.5$
ii. $z < 2.3$
iii. $z > -1.72$
iv. $z < -0.56$
v. \*$-2 < z < 1.34$
vi. \*$2.3 < z < 3.1$

**Try it yourself.** Use the explorer below to shade each region and read off the proportion. Enter the z-value(s) from each part above and check your hand-table answer against the live calculation.

```{=html}
<div class="ne-box" id="ne-std">
  <div class="ne-context">Standard Normal model: mean = 0, standard deviation = 1</div>
  <div class="ne-tabs">
    <button class="ne-tab-btn active" data-tab="area">Find a proportion</button>
    <button class="ne-tab-btn" data-tab="value">Find a cut-off value</button>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="area">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region">
          <option value="above">Greater than</option>
          <option value="below">Less than</option>
          <option value="between">Between two values</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label>z = <input type="number" step="0.01" class="ne-val1" placeholder="e.g. 1.5"></label>
      <span class="ne-val2-wrap" style="display:none;">and <input type="number" step="0.01" class="ne-val2" placeholder="e.g. 2.0"></span>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-area">
      <path class="ne-shade-area" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-area"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="value" style="display:none;">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region2">
          <option value="lowest">Lowest</option>
          <option value="highest">Highest</option>
          <option value="middle">Middle</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label><input type="number" class="ne-pct" value="10" min="1" max="99"> %</label>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-value">
      <path class="ne-shade-value" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-value"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>NE.init("ne-std", {mu:0, sigma:1, unit:"", symbol:"z", precision:2});</script>

<div class="qbox">
  <button class="btn" id="q1a-show">Show worked solutions (a)</button>
  <button class="btn" id="q1a-hide" style="display:none;">Hide worked solutions (a)</button>
  <div class="qbox-answer" id="q1a-model">
    <p><strong>i.</strong> $z>1.5$: from Table Z, area = 0.9332. Required area = 1 - 0.9332 = 0.0668, i.e. 6.68%.</p>
    <p><strong>ii.</strong> $z<2.3$: from Table Z, area = 0.9893, i.e. 98.93%.</p>
    <p><strong>iii.</strong> $z>-1.72$: from Table Z, area = 0.0427. Required area = 1 - 0.0427 = 0.9573, i.e. 95.73%.</p>
    <p><strong>iv.</strong> $z<-0.56$: from Table Z, area = 0.2877, i.e. 28.77%.</p>
    <p><strong>v.</strong> $-2<z<1.34$: area at $z=-2$ is 0.0228; area at $z=1.34$ is 0.9099. Required area = 0.9099 - 0.0228 = 0.8871, i.e. 88.71%.</p>
    <p><strong>vi.</strong> $2.3<z<3.1$: area at $z=2.3$ is 0.9893; area at $z=3.1$ is 0.9990. Required area = 0.9990 - 0.9893 = 0.0097, i.e. 0.97%.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const show=document.getElementById("q1a-show"), hide=document.getElementById("q1a-hide"), model=document.getElementById("q1a-model");
  show.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="block"; show.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="inline-block"; });
  hide.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="none"; show.style.display="inline-block"; });
})();
</script>
```

## Question 2: How do the males in Western Europe stack up?

Based on a Normal model with mean 179 cm and standard deviation of 7 cm describing the heights of males in a particular Western European country:

(a) What proportion of males will be taller than 184 cm?
(b) \*Below what height will the shortest 10% of the male population of this country be?
(c) \*What percentage of males from this country are between 175 and 185 cm tall?
(d) \*Calculate the interquartile range of heights of males from this country.
(e) \*Above what height are the tallest 5% of the males in this country?

**Use the explorer below** (already set to this context) to work through each part. For (a) and (c), use the "Find a proportion" tab. For (b), (d) and (e), use the "Find a cut-off value" tab (note that the IQR in (d) needs the middle 50% cut-offs).

```{=html}
<div class="ne-box" id="ne-heights">
  <div class="ne-context">Heights of males: mean = 179 cm, standard deviation = 7 cm</div>
  <div class="ne-tabs">
    <button class="ne-tab-btn active" data-tab="area">Find a proportion</button>
    <button class="ne-tab-btn" data-tab="value">Find a cut-off value</button>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="area">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region">
          <option value="above">Greater than</option>
          <option value="below">Less than</option>
          <option value="between">Between two values</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label>Height (cm) = <input type="number" step="0.1" class="ne-val1" placeholder="e.g. 184"></label>
      <span class="ne-val2-wrap" style="display:none;">and <input type="number" step="0.1" class="ne-val2" placeholder="e.g. 190"></span>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-area">
      <path class="ne-shade-area" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-area"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="value" style="display:none;">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region2">
          <option value="lowest">Lowest</option>
          <option value="highest">Highest</option>
          <option value="middle">Middle</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label><input type="number" class="ne-pct" value="10" min="1" max="99"> %</label>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-value">
      <path class="ne-shade-value" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-value"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>NE.init("ne-heights", {mu:179, sigma:7, unit:"cm", symbol:"height", precision:2});</script>

<div class="qbox">
  <button class="btn" id="q2-show">Show worked solutions</button>
  <button class="btn" id="q2-hide" style="display:none;">Hide worked solutions</button>
  <div class="qbox-answer" id="q2-model">
    <p><strong>(a)</strong> $z = (184-179)/7 = 0.71$. From Table Z, area = 0.7611, so 76.11% are shorter than 184cm. Required area = 1 - 0.7611 = 0.2389, so 23.89% of males will be taller than 184 cm.</p>
    <p><strong>(b)</strong> From Table Z with area = 0.10, $z = -1.28$. $y = 179 - 1.28 \times 7 = 170.04$ cm. 10% of the male population will be shorter than 170 cm.</p>
    <p><strong>(c)</strong> At $y=175$: $z=(175-179)/7=-0.57$, area = 0.2843. At $y=185$: $z=(185-179)/7=0.86$, area = 0.8051. Required area = 0.8051 - 0.2843 = 0.5208. About 52% of males will be between 175 and 185 cm tall.</p>
    <p><strong>(d)</strong> From Table Z with area = 0.25, $z=-0.67$: $y = 179 - 0.67 \times 7 = 174.31$ cm. With area = 0.75, $z=0.67$: $y = 179 + 0.67 \times 7 = 183.69$ cm. IQR = 183.69 - 174.31 = 9.38 cm.</p>
    <p><strong>(e)</strong> From Table Z with area = 0.95, $z=1.65$: $y = 179 + 1.65 \times 7 = 190.55$ cm. The tallest 5% of males will be taller than 190.55 cm.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const show=document.getElementById("q2-show"), hide=document.getElementById("q2-hide"), model=document.getElementById("q2-model");
  show.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="block"; show.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="inline-block"; });
  hide.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="none"; show.style.display="inline-block"; });
})();
</script>
```

## Question 3: Do they get what they pay for?

Management at a cereal company is concerned that the filling machine at their factory may need some further adjustment to obtain a better balance between the number of satisfied customers (they are getting the amount of cereal that they have paid for based on the advertised volume) and minimizing overfilling (loss of profit). The filling machine currently fills boxes based on a Normal model with mean 720 grams and standard deviation of 30 grams describing the weights of boxes of cereal of a particular variety.

(a) If boxes of this cereal are labelled as containing 700 grams, what proportion of customers are going to be dissatisfied with their purchase?
(b) \*Below what weight will the lightest 5% of boxes of this cereal be?
(c) \*What percentage of boxes of this cereal is between 700 grams and 750 grams?
(d) \*Above what weight are the heaviest 10% of boxes of this cereal?

```{=html}
<div class="ne-box" id="ne-cereal">
  <div class="ne-context">Cereal box weights: mean = 720 grams, standard deviation = 30 grams</div>
  <div class="ne-tabs">
    <button class="ne-tab-btn active" data-tab="area">Find a proportion</button>
    <button class="ne-tab-btn" data-tab="value">Find a cut-off value</button>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="area">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region">
          <option value="above">Greater than</option>
          <option value="below">Less than</option>
          <option value="between">Between two values</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label>Weight (g) = <input type="number" step="1" class="ne-val1" placeholder="e.g. 700"></label>
      <span class="ne-val2-wrap" style="display:none;">and <input type="number" step="1" class="ne-val2" placeholder="e.g. 750"></span>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-area">
      <path class="ne-shade-area" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-area"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ne-panel" data-panel="value" style="display:none;">
    <div class="ne-controls">
      <label>Region:
        <select class="ne-region2">
          <option value="lowest">Lowest</option>
          <option value="highest">Highest</option>
          <option value="middle">Middle</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label><input type="number" class="ne-pct" value="5" min="1" max="99"> %</label>
    </div>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 600 210" class="ne-svg-value">
      <path class="ne-shade-value" fill="#ffdca8" stroke="none"></path>
      <path class="ne-outline" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"></path>
    </svg>
    <div class="ne-result-value"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>NE.init("ne-cereal", {mu:720, sigma:30, unit:"g", symbol:"weight", precision:1});</script>

<div class="qbox">
  <button class="btn" id="q3-show">Show worked solutions</button>
  <button class="btn" id="q3-hide" style="display:none;">Hide worked solutions</button>
  <div class="qbox-answer" id="q3-model">
    <p><strong>(a)</strong> $z=(700-720)/30=-0.67$. From Table Z, area = 0.2514, so 25.14% of customers will receive less than 700 grams.</p>
    <p><strong>(b)</strong> From Table Z with area = 0.05, $z=-1.64$. $y = 720 - 1.64 \times 30 = 670.8$ grams. 5% of boxes will be lighter than 670.8 grams.</p>
    <p><strong>(c)</strong> At $y=700$: $z=-0.67$, area = 0.2514. At $y=750$: $z=1.00$, area = 0.8413. Required area = 0.8413 - 0.2514 = 0.5899. About 59% of boxes will be between 700 and 750 grams.</p>
    <p><strong>(d)</strong> From Table Z with area = 0.90, $z=1.28$. $y = 720 + 1.28 \times 30 = 758.4$ grams. 10% of boxes will be heavier than 758.4 grams.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const show=document.getElementById("q3-show"), hide=document.getElementById("q3-hide"), model=document.getElementById("q3-model");
  show.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="block"; show.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="inline-block"; });
  hide.addEventListener("click", ()=>{ model.style.display="none"; hide.style.display="none"; show.style.display="inline-block"; });
})();
</script>
```

## Question 4: Comparing two groups based on summary statistics

*Who should get the prize? Is there much chance that anyone would have scored a better result than the prizewinner?*

The local school gives one prize for Social Studies at the end of the school year. Two subjects are studied in the Social Studies discipline - history and geography. George studied history and obtained a result of 86 marks out of 100 overall for the year. Ringo studied geography and obtained a result of 89 marks out of 100 overall for the year.

### (a) {-}

Before Speech Night some students in the class thought that Ringo was a certainty to get the Social Studies prize. Explain the students' reasoning. Do you agree?

```{=html}
<div class="qbox">
  <textarea id="q4a-answer" placeholder="Your answer..."></textarea>
  <label class="qchk"><input type="checkbox" id="q4a-marked"> Marked correct</label><br>

  <button class="btn" id="q4a-hide" style="display:none;">Hide model answer</button>
  <div class="qbox-answer" id="q4a-model">
    <p>At first it would seem reasonable for Ringo to be awarded the prize as he got more marks than George, however it does not take into account how good their marks were compared with the others in their respective classes.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

### (b) {-}

The Social Studies HOD (Head of Department) studied statistics at university and thought that she had a fair solution. She knew that the distribution of marks in the history class had a mean of 63 with a standard deviation of 12 and the distribution of marks in the geography class had a mean of 60 with a standard deviation of 16. Explain how she could use this information to arrive at a fair solution, and calculate the z-score for each student.

```{=html}
<div class="zcheck-box">
  <p style="margin-top:0;">Calculate each student's z-score and check your answer.</p>
  <div class="zcheck-row" id="q4b-george-row">
    <label>George's z-score (history, mean 63, SD 12):</label>
    <input type="number" step="0.001" id="q4b-george">
    <button class="btn" data-check="q4b-george" data-answer="1.917">Check</button>
    <span id="q4b-george-fb"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="zcheck-row" id="q4b-ringo-row">
    <label>Ringo's z-score (geography, mean 60, SD 16):</label>
    <input type="number" step="0.001" id="q4b-ringo">
    <button class="btn" data-check="q4b-ringo" data-answer="1.813">Check</button>
    <span id="q4b-ringo-fb"></span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-check]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const id = btn.dataset.check;
      const input = document.getElementById(id);
      const fb = document.getElementById(id + "-fb");
      const row = document.getElementById(id + "-row");
      const key = Number(btn.dataset.answer);
      const val = Number(input.value);
      row.classList.remove("correct","incorrect");
      if (!isNaN(val) && Math.abs(val - key) < 0.02) {
        row.classList.add("correct");
        fb.textContent = "Correct.";
      } else {
        row.classList.add("incorrect");
        fb.textContent = "Not quite - try again.";
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="cl-wrap" id="m3-checklist">
  <div class="cl-card">
    <h4>Module 3 &mdash; Checklist</h4>

      Once you have watched the lecture recordings, completed the tutorial activity,

      <span class="cl-note">(* denotes expanded competencies)</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="cl-card">
    <div class="cl-group-title">Using the Normal Model</div>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-1">
      <span>Standardise the value of a variable.</span>
    </label>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-2">
      <span>Use standardised values to make comparisons.</span>
    </label>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-3">
      <span>Understand what is meant by a Normal model.</span>
    </label>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-4">
      <span>Understand the difference between &mu; and &yacute;; and &sigma; and s.</span>
    </label>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-5">
      <span>Use Standard Normal Tables to find proportions above or below calculated Z-scores in problems associated with a Normal distribution.</span>
    </label>

    <label class="cl-item">
      <input type="checkbox" data-id="m3-6">
      <span class="cl-adv">* Use Standard Normal Tables to find proportions between calculated Z-scores in problems associated with a Normal distribution.</span>
    </label>

      <span class="cl-adv">* Use Standard Normal Tables in reverse to find values in problems associated with a Normal distribution.</span>
    </label>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  const ROOT = document.getElementById("m3-checklist");
  const KEY  = "m3-checklist-v1";

  const boxes = Array.from(ROOT.querySelectorAll("input[type=checkbox][data-id]"));
  const bar   = ROOT.querySelector(".cl-bar");
  const stats = ROOT.querySelector(".cl-stats");
  const btnAll   = ROOT.querySelector('[data-action="all"]');
  const btnClear = ROOT.querySelector('[data-action="clear"]');

  function update(){
    const total = boxes.length;
    const done  = boxes.filter(b => b.checked).length;
    const pct   = total ? Math.round(100 * done / total) : 0;
    bar.style.width = pct + "%";
    stats.textContent = done + " of " + total + " completed (" + pct + "%)";
  }

  function save(){
    const state = {};
    boxes.forEach(b => state[b.dataset.id] = b.checked);
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    update();
  }

  function load(){
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "{}");
    boxes.forEach(b => b.checked = !!saved[b.dataset.id]);
    update();
  }

  boxes.forEach(b => b.addEventListener("change", save));

  btnAll.addEventListener("click", () => { boxes.forEach(b => b.checked = true); save(); });
  btnClear.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!confirm("Clear all ticks for this checklist on this device?")) return;
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
    boxes.forEach(b => b.checked = false);
    update();
  });

  load();
})();
</script>
```
